 At Jammu

sentences.text:
. In the instant petition, the petitioner has challenged FIR No. 11/2023 dated 16.02.2023,
registered at Police Station Women Cell, Rajouri for the commission of offences under Sections 376,
323, 447, 504, 120-B IPC.
The petitioner has also filed Bail Application No. 73/2023 under Section 438 CrPC seeking bail in anticipation of his arrest in the aforesaid FIR.
02. This Court vide order dated 17.03.2023 had granted an interim bail to the petitioner.

The response stands filed by the respondent wherein it is stated that on the basis of the statements of the witnesses and the statements of the inhabitants of the place of occurrence which are recorded by the I.O concerned under Section 161 CrPC and the statements of three witnesses under section 164 CrPC recorded by the Court of learned District Mobile Magistrate (T), Rajouri, facts and circumstances of the investigation, the case has been closed as not- admitted vide Final Report No. 02/2023 dated Mohd Saleem vs Ut Of J&K on 11 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74288913/
1 09.07.2023.

entities.text: Mohd Saleem vs Ut Of J&K
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is further stated that the Final Report in case FIR No. 11/2023 dated 16.02.2023 under Sections 376, 323, 447, 504, 120-B IPC, registered at Police Station Women Cell, Rajouri has been produced before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rajouri on 10.07.2024.
03.

In view of the objections filed by the respondents, the order dated 17.03.2023 passed in the bail application is made absolute and the CRM(M) No. 220/2023 is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to approach this Court in case any adverse order passed in the Final Report.

(MOKSHA KHAJURIA KAZMI) JUDGE JAMMU 11.10.2024 Vijay Mohd Saleem vs Ut Of J&K on 11 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74288913/
